Counsel for Applicant :- Irfan Alam Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.
None appears on behalf of the complainant although notices are served.
This is the second bail application.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 21.09.2022.

It is alleged in the FIR that on 31.06.2021 at about 9 AM, while the daughter of the informant went towards field which is near the school, finding her lonely, the accused persons (two in number) have dragged her to the school and inside the school, she was raped by them one by one.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that statement of the victim under Section 161 and 164 Kallu vs State Of Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83833494/
1 Cr.P.C. are different.

sentences.text: While making statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has made improvement.
He further submits that the applicant is languishing in jail since 23.06.2023.
There is no corroborative evidence in support of the prosecution case.
Per contra, learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
He submits that 10 years old victim has been raped by two persons.
Statements of the prosecutrix under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., before the doctor as well as in the examination-in-chief are intact.
Everywhere she has said that both the accused persons dragged her to school and raped her.
It has been further submitted by the learned AGA that there is corroborative medical evidence.

He submits that Dr. Pawan Kumar Gupta, Medical Officer at PHC Balrampur has found one injury i.e.
pain over ingunil and periniel region and has kept that injury under observation.
He further submits that statement of the prosecutrix at every stage is intact and has been supported by the medical evidence.
It is a heinous offence upon a ten year old child.
On due consideration to the submission advanced as well as perusal of the record, so also the statement of the prosecutrix and the medical report, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant Kallu involved in case crime/FIR No.095 of 2021,
under Sections 376-DB IPC read with Sections 5(M)/6 POCSO Act lodged at Police Station Pachpedwa, District Balrampur is hereby rejected.
At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant prays that the trial court may be directed to conclude the trial.
Accordingly, learned trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the aforementioned case crime number preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of the order.
Let a copy of this order be transmitted before the trial court.

Order Date :- 16.1.2024 R.C.
